notes: Delete mirror of biology-replace-0001. The stored fact is removed; the type 1 diabetes and insulinoma queries keep the pancreas in the by-name worlds and become not known in the description worlds. The neck query was rephrased around the original value (abdomen, through 'the pancreas is in the abdomen'), and is not known in every world. The zh query names insulin in English with a Chinese gloss, because 胰岛素 contains 胰 (pancreas) and would give the original answer away (R2).
